title: Verified upstream design skill candidates
status: Curated REI workflow adapters. Upstream source skill bodies not copied, external tools not installed.
selection: Public active repository and confirmed specific upstream SKILL.md file. GitHub star rankings are only a discovery signal; counts not retained as quality evidence.

items.purpose: Design production-grade company websites with distinctive art direction, real assets, and browser-verified polish.
items.checks: Visual hierarchy, authentic asset licensing, layout consistency, screenshot evidence, and approved animation.

items.purpose: Critique and polish layouts, typography, colors, responsive interactions, and accessibility of existing UIs.
items.checks: Document critique findings and rerun visual and keyboard tests after improvements.

items.purpose: Produce editable, precise technical and architectural diagrams as HTML and SVG.
items.checks: Verify labels, arrows, scale, meaning, contrast and export against the technical source.

items.purpose: Create intentionally art-directed new web pages without repetitive generated styling.
items.checks: Keep user-owned brand tokens and validate design originality and mobile layouts.

items.purpose: Implement appropriate motion and transitions in real components with interruption and reduced-motion behavior.
items.checks: Measure motion performance, reduced-motion handling and exit timing.

items.purpose: Review and critique existing interface motion implementations with code and visual evidence.
items.checks: Record actual animation review scope and verified regressions.

items.purpose: Build responsive browser-rendered design artifacts and verify visual outcomes in a running app.
items.checks: Capture viewport screenshots and confirm meaningful interaction, keyboard behavior, and loading states.

items.purpose: Review changed UI code and detect newly introduced layout, accessibility, text and interaction regressions.
items.checks: Diff-based severity ratings, screenshots, verified fixes and regression tests.

items.purpose: Audit implemented web interfaces against documented design and accessibility requirements.
items.checks: Avoid claims of live audit without rendered screenshots and browser observations.
